test_cases.name: just_go_two_hander
test_cases.input: Just go. 8 minute hybrid psychological thriller-horror short. 2 actors, one night interior. A night clerk finds someone already signed into the logbook under her name.
assertions: outputs a Locked Sheet before the Fountain draft
no character names the theme or says they are scared
final image is photographable and unexplained

test_cases.name: rewrite_on_the_nose_scene
test_cases.input: Punch up this scene. The guard says 'I don't know what's real anymore' and the stranger explains the building is a metaphor for guilt.
assertions: replaces explanation with behavior or an object

test_cases.name: shot_pack_after_draft
test_cases.input: Turn the approved 10-minute draft into Seedance/Kling shot prompts. Do not change the story.
assertions: each shot has IMAGE SOUND WITHHOLD and PROMPT
continuity header repeats wardrobe and unclean object state

test_cases.name: refuse_feature_bloat

assertions: offers to compress into an 8-12 minute short or refuses the feature scope
